blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur— The Caraga (Region 13) police arrested 26 wanted individuals in a series of coordinated operations on Saturday, November 7, highlighted by the capture of the region’s fourth most wanted person (MWP) in Esperanza, Agusan del Sur. Brig. Gen. Rolindo Suguilon, Police Regional Office-13 (PRO-13) director, said the one-day operations yielded eight suspects listed on the region’s MWP roster alongside 18 other wanted individuals. Among the high-profile arrests was 31-year-old alias “Elmer,” a farmer and resident of Purok 5, Barangay Nato, Esperanza.
